caseName: West v. Comm'r of Internal Revenue
caseNameFull: David WEST v. COMMISSIONER OF INTERNAL REVENUE.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner allowed until January 30, 2017, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule *71038(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
